hints.title: Parity Partition Invariant
hints.text: Any two characters at positions with the same parity (both even or both odd) can be permuted arbitrarily via repeated adjacent parity swaps.

hints.title: Frequency Decomposition
hints.text: Characters at even positions cannot move to odd positions, and vice versa.

hints.title: Multiset Equality
hints.text: Check whether character frequency counts match between s1 and s2 on even indices, and also on odd indices.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: length of strings s1 and s2
complexity.notes: Sorting even and odd character slices.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Graph search over string permutations is factorial.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for character slices.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Decompose into even-indexed and odd-indexed multiset comparisons.
